name: smwblocks-crouch-and-freeze
title: Crouch and Freeze
description:
Makes Mario crouch/duck (Or whatever you call it), and freezes him.
To be used for opening scenes (Or really mean kaizo-like hacks).
Warning: Completely freezes the game if Mario dies.
...But you shouldn't let that happen on the intro message/screen anyway.

Requested by Wigglytuff.
